details:
Currently, accessing specific avatar features (like clothing toggles, props, or expressions) requires opening the radial Action Menu and manually navigating through sub-menus.

This is a massive disadvantage for Desktop users. Unlike VR players—who can seamlessly trigger expressions using physical hand gestures or interact with Contact Receivers on their bodies—Desktop players have zero physical workarounds. To change an outfit or trigger a prop, a Desktop user must completely halt their character's movement, look away from the action, hold 'R', and fiddle with a mouse cursor in a radial menu. This completely breaks gameplay flow and immersion.

I would like to request a Per-Avatar Keybinding / Quick Access system for the Action Menu, with a major focus on empowering Desktop players, while also benefiting VR users.

• For Desktop Users: Allow players to bind specific avatar parameters, toggles, or sub-menu buttons directly to keyboard keys (e.g., NumPad, Function keys, or custom combinations like Ctrl + [Key]).

• For VR Users: Allow mapping specific avatar actions to unused controller inputs or chord combinations (e.g., Double Tap + Grip).

How it should work:

1. While using an avatar, players could open a "Hotkeys" config option in the Action Menu.

2. They select any toggle, button, or expression from that specific avatar's menu.

3. They press a key on their keyboard (or controller) to bind that specific action.

4. These custom hotkeys would save per avatar, meaning switching avatars would automatically load that specific avatar's keybindings.

VR players can rely on physical hand gestures (Fist, Peace sign, etc.) or Contact Receivers (touching their shoulder to draw a sword). Desktop players have absolutely no equivalent to this. The standard Shift + F1-F8 gestures are extremely limited, outdated, and do not work for custom 3.0 avatar toggles. Desktop players are completely locked behind tedious menu navigation.

This feature would bridge the massive quality-of-life gap between VR and Desktop players. It would drastically improve the user experience for roleplayers, desktop dancers, performance artists, and casual players alike. Furthermore, it serves as a major accessibility upgrade for players who find navigating radial menus physically difficult or tedious.
title: Per-Avatar Keybindings / Hotkeys for Action Menu Toggles (Desktop & VR)
